lvis_v1.free_feasibility_note: Annotations small; reuses COCO images. Free.

openimages_v7_segmentation.free_feasibility_note: Very large overall; must subset to mask-bearing classes. Free.

openimages_v7_segmentation.name: Open Images V7 (segmentation subset)

recommended_next_domain.first_local_check: Confirm no COCO files already exist locally, then plan a small val2017 subset (do NOT download yet): ls ade20k_root ade20kdataset && find / -iname 'instances_val2017.json' 2>/dev/null | head
recommended_next_domain.why: Direct class overlap (chair/couch/car/dining table) with instance masks ideal for single-object removal, permissive annotation license, mature CPU tooling, and free val2017 subset -- the lowest-friction independent second domain.
